parameters.sqlQuery: WITH params AS (SELECT CURRENT_DATE('America/New_York') AS report_end_date, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('America/New_York'), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AS report_start_date), DiscountedBeddingSKUs AS (SELECT DISTINCT op.OpPrSKU, 1 - (op.GrossRevenueStable / (op.ListPrice * op.OpQty)) AS discount_rate, 5 * FLOOR((1 - (op.GrossRevenueStable / (op.ListPrice * op.OpQty))) * 100 / 5) AS discount_bucket_pct FROM `wf-gcp-us-ae-sf-prod.curated_data_hub.tbl_fact_order_financials` AS orders CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN UNNEST(orders.OpMetrics) AS op WHERE orders.OrderDate_EST BETWEEN params.report_start_date AND params.report_end_date AND op.OpPrSkuCategoryName = 'Bedding' AND op.ListPrice > 0 AND op.OpQty > 0 AND (1 - (op.GrossRevenueStable / (op.ListPrice * op.OpQty))) >= 0), SessionsViewingDiscountedBedding AS (SELECT DISTINCT clicks.Event_SessionKey, skus.discount_bucket_pct FROM `wf-gcp-us-ae-sf-prod.curated_clickstream.tbl_dash_clicks` AS clicks INNER JOIN DiscountedBeddingSKUs AS skus ON clicks.Event_PrSKU = skus.OpPrSKU CROSS JOIN params WHERE clicks.SessionStartDate BETWEEN params.report_start_date AND params.report_end_date AND MOD(ABS(FARM_FINGERPRINT(clicks.Event_SessionKey)), 10) = 0) SELECT s.discount_bucket_pct, CONCAT(CAST(s.discount_bucket_pct AS STRING), '-', CAST(s.discount_bucket_pct + 5 AS STRING), '%') AS discount_bucket_label, SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(SUM(visits.Converted) AS FLOAT64) * 100, COUNT(DISTINCT visits.Event_SessionKey)) AS conversion_rate_for_discounted_bedding_viewers, COUNT(DISTINCT visits.Event_SessionKey) AS sessions FROM `wf-gcp-us-ae-sf-prod.curated_clickstream.tbl_dash_visits` AS visits INNER JOIN SessionsViewingDiscountedBedding AS s ON visits.Event_SessionKey = s.Event_SessionKey CROSS JOIN params WHERE visits.SessionStartDate BETWEEN params.report_start_date AND params.report_end_date GROUP BY s.discount_bucket_pct ORDER BY s.discount_bucket_pct;
